tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search travel eSIM data plans for a destination country. Returns plans with data allowance, validity in days, and USD price. Use this first when a user wants mobile data for a trip (e.g. "5GB in Italy for 10 days"). Returns a plan_id to pass to get_quote / purchase.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Confirm the current USD price for a specific eSIM plan before purchasing. Returns the full plan plus a price breakdown and a short-lived quote. Call after search_plans, before purchase.

tools.name: get_ai_line_offer
tools.description: MeiSIM's current offer for real US phone lines used by AI agents: the monthly price per number for texts, and for texts plus voice over SIP; the first-term minimum; what a line includes (a real US mobile number on a national carrier, inbound texts to a webhook or over the API, voice over SIP with th

tools.name: search_us_numbers
tools.description: Find real US phone-number plans (a genuine US carrier line with calls, texts, and data, no SSN or contract). Use this when the user wants an actual US number, not just travel data. Returns a plan_id for purchase.

tools.name: purchase
tools.description: Begin buying an eSIM plan. Returns a secure Stripe payment link the customer opens to pay with their own card; the eSIM + QR are emailed automatically once payment clears. Poll get_activation with the returned order_id to fetch the QR. Safe to retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: get_activation
tools.description: Get the eSIM install QR code, activation (LPA) string, and status for an order. Pass the order_id from purchase. Status is "ready" when the profile can be installed (after the customer pays).

tools.name: topup_lookup
tools.description: Look up an existing US prepaid line (by phone) or an eSIM (by ICCID / order) and list the top-up plans available for it. Returns product_ids to pass to topup_start.

tools.name: topup_start
tools.description: Start a top-up/recharge for an existing line or eSIM, using a product_id from topup_lookup. Returns an order_id and a payment URL where the customer completes payment. For range plans, pass custom_amount.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the MeiSIM account behind your API key: company, status, prepaid wallet balance in USD, and how many new numbers you may still activate today. Use before buy_numbers, or when the user asks what is left. Needs your API key.

tools.name: get_number_pricing
tools.description: Show what a new US number costs on your MeiSIM account and whether you can order: the daily rate (minimum days, one-time activation fee, how many are ready right now) and the monthly rate (first month, renewals, minimum months), with and without voice. Call before buy_numbers. Needs your API key.

tools.name: buy_numbers
tools.description: Order new US phone numbers on your MeiSIM account, paid from its prepaid wallet. Prepaid: no returns, no refunds once a number is delivered. Choose billing "daily" (a minimum number of days paid now, then each day from the wallet) or "monthly" (a minimum number of months paid up front). A monthly or

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Check a number order from buy_numbers: status (provisioning, partially_fulfilled, fulfilled, delayed, cancelled, closed_refunded), the numbers delivered so far and what was charged. Pass the order_id or your customer_reference. Needs your API key.

tools.name: list_my_numbers
tools.description: List the US phone numbers on your MeiSIM account: number, status, whether it has voice, how it is billed and the date it is paid through. Paged; pass next_offset to continue. Needs your API key.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read the text messages received on your MeiSIM numbers, newest first. Filter to one number and/or to messages after a timestamp. To follow a conversation, pass the received_at of the last message you saw as since. Needs your API key.

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Wait for the next text message on one of your MeiSIM numbers and return it. Blocks up to timeout_seconds (default 30, max 50). Pass since as the time you started waiting (default: now) so an older message is not mistaken for the new one. If nothing arrives, received is false; call again to keep wait

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message from one of your MeiSIM numbers to a US number. Sending must be enabled on your account and each number has a monthly allowance; a refusal tells you which. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_messages · Private data: get_account, get_number_pricing, buy_numbers, get_order, list_my_numbers, read_messages, wait_for_message, send_message · Public sink: get_ai_line_offer, send_message · Destructive: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_messages · Private data: get_account, get_number_pricing, buy_numbers, get_order, list_my_numbers, read_messages, wait_for_message, send_message · Public sink: get_ai_line_offer, send_message · Destructive: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
